champions.name: Annie
champions.tldr: New Effect: Now refunds the mana cost and 50% of the cooldown if the target dies while the projectile is in flight.
champions.gameplayImpact: Annie is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now refunds the mana cost and 50% of the cooldown if the target dies while the projectile is in flight.

champions.gameplayImpact: Ashe is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Ashe's basic attacks deal bonus damage equal to (75% + Infinity Edge|40%) critical strike chance|critical chance}}. Additionally, her basic attacks and ability hits apply Frost to enemies for 2 seconds, which slow them by 20–30% for the duration.

lines.label: Change
